sources.title: Planning applications
sources.verified_claim: Sport England explains its planning role for major sports facilities, playing pitches and certain large developments, and notes that pre-application advice was temporarily suspended from 1 July 2026 due to capacity constraints. Consultation process is not parcel sporting capacity.

sources.title: Playing fields policy
sources.verified_claim: Sport England states LPAs must consult it on applications affecting playing fields and that it normally opposes loss unless one of five exceptions applies. Policy protection does not establish whether a sample parcel is a playing field.

sources.title: Our planning role, guidance and tools
sources.verified_claim: Sport England's planning guidance calls for robust, up-to-date needs assessments and strategies to protect, enhance and provide sports facilities. Strategic needs evidence is not exact parcel facility capacity.

sources.title: Top ratings for Enfield leisure centres after major investment
sources.verified_claim: Enfield reports recent investment and high Quest ratings at three leisure centres, with visits increasing after refurbishment. Facility quality and borough usage do not establish sports capacity at parcel_30762.

sources.title: BSL Sport and leisure
sources.verified_claim: Enfield's live accessibility page describes a five-year Active and Creative sport and physical-activity strategy and inclusive leisure provision. The page is older, so strategy-age uncertainty is retained rather than assumed current beyond its stated term.

sources.title: Leisure centres
sources.verified_claim: Havering lists council-supported leisure centres and a range of health, fitness and sport facilities. Borough facility inventory does not prove accessibility, headroom or development need at parcel_46142.

sources.title: Leisure centres
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth's current map lists nine leisure and sports facilities with differing pitches, pools, gyms and courts. Inventory presence does not establish exact capacity or deficiency at parcel_61522.

sources.title: Lambeth: Aiming to get everyone active
sources.verified_claim: Lambeth reports adoption of the Active Lambeth Strategy 2022-27 to connect sport and physical activity with health, transport, education and community safety. Strategy goals do not establish sample-parcel facility delivery.
